info.title: Astro Blog API
info.description: Public endpoints used by the website (likes, shares, subscribe, feedback) and the admin API used by the admin app (cookie sp_admin, set by POST /api/auth/login).

blogName.description: Blog name used in e-mail subjects and signatures

notifyTo.description: Who is e-mailed about new feedback (and new subscribers, when on)

notifyOnFeedback.description: E-mail the notify list when feedback with a message arrives

notifyOnSubscribe.description: E-mail the notify list when someone confirms a subscription

acknowledgeFeedback.description: Thank readers who leave an e-mail address with their feedback

sendWelcome.description: Send a welcome e-mail once a subscription is confirmed

signature.description: Appended to every e-mail to readers

digestFooter.description: Shown at the bottom of every digest, above the unsubscribe link (e.g. your postal address)

blogName.description: Blog name used in e-mail subjects and signatures

notifyTo.description: Who is e-mailed about new feedback (and new subscribers, when on)

notifyOnFeedback.description: E-mail the notify list when feedback with a message arrives

notifyOnSubscribe.description: E-mail the notify list when someone confirms a subscription

acknowledgeFeedback.description: Thank readers who leave an e-mail address with their feedback

sendWelcome.description: Send a welcome e-mail once a subscription is confirmed

signature.description: Appended to every e-mail to readers

digestFooter.description: Shown at the bottom of every digest, above the unsubscribe link (e.g. your postal address)

reset.description: true = password reset for an existing user; false = first-time invite

link.description: The invite / reset link, to copy if the e-mail did not arrive

mailError.description: Why the e-mail could not be sent

liked.description: Whether this visitor has liked the post

csv.description: CSV text with an "email" column (and optionally "name", "topics" separated by ";")

consented.description: true = add as active (you already hold their consent); false = add as pending and send each a confirm e-mail

postSlug.description: Slug of the post the feedback is about; empty = general feedback

id.description: Id to attach a message to a vote just sent

postTitle.description: Title of the post, from the site feed

post.description: The post as the site feed (or the send snapshot) describes it

audience.description: Active subscribers whose topics match the post

to.description: Defaults to your own account e-mail

posts.description: Published posts in the site feed

feedUnavailable.description: True when the API could not read the site feed (titles are missing)

subscribersPerWeek.description: Confirmed subscriptions per week, last 12 weeks (key = Monday, YYYY-MM-DD)

sharesByNetwork.description: Share clicks by network, all time
